images.title: Square minus the middle bar
images.purpose: Shows the slanted region as an x by x square with a y wide bar down its middle, so its area is x² − xy.
images.composition: One I shaped figure centred: a square with bars above and below and a bar through its middle. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: An x by x square region outlined in dark. Directly above it and touching its top edge, outside the square, an amber (#E69F00) bar x long and y tall; directly below it and touching its bottom edge, outside the square, an identical amber bar. Inside the square, an amber vertical bar y wide running the full height x, centred. The two parts of the square left and right of the middle bar are filled with teal (#0072B2) slanted hatching lines. Labels: 'x' above the top bar for its length, 'x' beside the left side of the square for its height, 'y' under a small arrow across the middle bar width. Centred below the figure: 'x² − xy' and under it in reddish purple (#CC79A7) 'x = 8, y = 3: area 40'. Exactly 3 bars and 2 hatched parts; no letters at corners.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Every correct method gives x² − xy, which is 40 when x = 8 and y = 3.
images.description: Shows the slanted region as an x by x square with a y wide bar down its middle, so its area is x² − xy.
images.context: x(x + 2y) − 3xy = x² − xy; x(x − y) = x² − xy; 64 − 24 = 40.

image_decisions.why: The figure is what all three methods describe; drawn cleanly it shows why each gives x² − xy.
